// make_ended: how testdata/ended/*.jsonl were made (paddock#66). Each line is a
// session.ended ecu published for the recording, in protobuf's JSON form, in
// order. Made once from ecu at tag v0.1.11 (the live release) by dropping this
// file into ecu's internal/race as zz_podium_gen_test.go, which replays the
// recordings in process with the race machine's own test helpers (no NATS, the
// frames dated from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z as v1's replay --clock does):
//
//	PODIUM_OUT=DIR go test ./internal/race/ -run TestZZPodiumGen -count=1
//
// restart-pair.jsonl is ecu's restart pair (internal/race/continue_test.go):
// real-nuc-suzuka-before-restart-2026-10-18 to a graceful stop, then a new
// machine continuing the session from the record it left, through
// real-nuc-suzuka-joined-mid-race-2026-10-18, 8.7 s later.

package race

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/those-who-run/contracts/ce"
)

func TestZZPodiumGen(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("PODIUM_OUT")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	write := func(name string, outs []Output) {
		var buf []byte
		for _, o := range outs {
			if o.Ended == nil {
				continue
			}
			b, err := ce.Marshal(o.Ended)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			buf = append(append(buf, b...), '\n')
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name+".jsonl"), buf, 0o600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, name := range []string{
		"real-nuc-suzuka-no-stop-2026-10-15", "real-nuc-suzuka-pit-stop-2026-10-15",
		"real-nuc-fuji-timed-2026-10-15", "real-nuc-suzuka-timed-race-2026-10-16",
		"real-quali-restart-quit-2026-10-14", "real-nuc-spa-pit-cut-quit-2026-10-18",
		"real-nuc-sugo-restarts-2026-10-18",
	} {
		write(name, replay(t, name))
	}
	p := restartPair(t, restartGap, window, 0)
	write("restart-pair", append(p.first, p.second...))
}
